name: code-quality
title: Testing, debugging, refactoring and documentation
summary: Keep code correct and changeable: test strategy, unit, integration, end-to-end, contract and visual tests, test data and flaky tests, debugging method, refactoring, clippy, the type system and unsafe policy, and technical documentation.
useWhen: Write tests for this code, or tell me what is worth testing
Set up cargo-nextest, database tests or browser end-to-end tests for this project
This test is flaky, or the suite is too slow
I cannot figure out why this bug happens
Refactor this code without breaking it
Should we rewrite this or fix it in place?
Set up clippy, rustfmt, workspace lints and an unsafe policy
Write the README, architecture notes or developer docs
A bug only happens in production and I cannot reproduce it
Find what keeps growing the server's memory using a heap profiler
